summary.intent: Run the full E2E test suite against branch changes, investigate failures, and fix them. User also wanted to identify when CI started breaking and migrate E2E auth to wallet-based authentication.
summary.outcome: Fixed 3 root causes: (1) SDK extraction broke E2E imports, (2) load test added in PR #288 was timing out all CI runs, (3) premature isAuthenticated flag caused race condition. Migrated all 6 E2E test suites from brittle Zustand-injection auth to wallet-based SIWE auth. Also implemented and shipped share-aware key re-wrapping in the CipherBoxClient SDK, fixing the 'No re-wrapped file key available' bug for files added to already-shared folders.

repo: SDK extraction (this branch) moved initializeVault, encryptVaultKeys, decryptVaultKeys from @cipherbox/crypto to @cipherbox/core — E2E imports were not updated
load-test.spec.ts was added in PR #288 (March 8) without being excluded from the default Playwright config, causing all CI E2E runs to time out at 15 minutes since then
The someguy sidecar (phase 19) is only in staging docker-compose, not in CI — it was not the cause of CI failures
E2E tests previously used loginViaTestEndpoint with Zustand state injection and reinjectTestAuthAfterReload workarounds; wallet-based SIWE via @johanneskares/wallet-mock is the stable alternative
The conflict-detection tests hit the API throttler (10 req/s, 100 req/min) when bumpServerSequence is called in rapid succession across 3 tests

When a file is uploaded to an already-shared folder, file keys were only wrapped for the uploader — recipients got 'No re-wrapped file key available' because re-wrapping was manual and missed in the upload path

code.finding: setAccessToken() was called before initializeOrLoadVault() completed, setting isAuthenticated:true prematurely and triggering Login.tsx redirect before SDK was initialized. Fix: split into setAccessToken (token only) + setAuthenticated() called after vault init.
setAccessToken action was setting isAuthenticated:true as a side effect. New setAuthenticated() action added to decouple token storage from auth state.

uploadFile and createFolder now call reWrapNewItems() after successful publish, using ShareCallbacks (getCoveringShares + addShareKeys) injected at client construction time. Re-wrap errors are caught and emitted as share:reWrapFailed events rather than propagating.
uploadFile return type extended to include fileKey (Uint8Array) so the stateful SDK client can perform re-wrapping with it after upload.

loginViaWallet needed a waitForFunction check for vault keys in Zustand store after login — without it, file operations fail with 'SDK not initialized' because the app navigates to /files before vault init completes.
Added 2s delay before bumpServerSequence calls to avoid 429 rate limit from API throttler. afterAll hook timeout increased to 60s.
Token refresh interceptor correctly needs to keep setAuthenticated:true since user is already in an authenticated session — this call site was left unchanged.

workflow: When investigating flaky CI, check for new test files that weren't excluded from the default test runner config before assuming app regressions
Serial Playwright test suites mean a single flaky test can skip 10+ downstream tests — fixing root causes matters more than increasing timeouts

When a TypeScript replace_all hits import type aliases as well as variable names, it can corrupt import statements (WalletTestAccount → WalletWalletTestAccount) — verify with grep after bulk replacements
The CI fix commit (reWrapForRecipients mock returning undefined) was not staged with the feature commit — a local passing test suite doesn't guarantee CI passes if the mock setup differs

friction: replace_all on TestAccount also hit import alias names, causing WalletTestAccount → WalletWalletTestAccount corruption requiring manual fix
client.ts error handling fix was never staged — only the test file was committed, causing CI failure after push
reWrapForRecipients mock returned undefined by default, causing destructuring failure in CI but not locally (vitest mock behavior difference)
Full-workflow reload test (3.8) is inherently flaky due to Core Kit Sapphire Devnet latency variance — required multiple timeout increases across the session
E2E .env pointed to staging API while local servers were on localhost:3000, causing confusing mixed-environment failures during debugging
open_items: Full-workflow test 3.8 (breadcrumb navigation after reload) remains intermittently flaky due to Core Kit Sapphire Devnet IPNS resolution latency — not fully resolved, just given longer timeouts
load-test.spec.ts has a pre-existing TypeScript error (tsc reports it) — not fixed in this session

The web app race condition fix (setAuthenticated after vault init) was applied, but the E2E vault-ready waitForFunction workaround in wallet-login-helpers.ts should be removed once the app fix is verified stable
The VITE_API_URL fallback in useAuth.ts uses window.location.origin + '/api' instead of localhost:3000 — inconsistent with rest of app, potential confusion in non-local environments
